title: He Documents Philly, With His Baby on His Chest!

people.name: Jay Espinal
people.phillyBased: not stated in transcript; asks about the street photography community 'here in Philly' and Spencer says 'We're both in a gallery right now'
people.shootsInVideo: no evidence in captions that the host made frames

people.name: Spencer (@EyeChutePhilly, ishootfilly.com as captioned)
people.phillyBased: yes, as stated: walked home in West Philly earlier, then 'I'd moved to South Philly'; 'my third year of doing street photos in Philly'; grew up mostly in North Carolina
people.shootsInVideo: yes, makes frames during the walk with daughter Lyndon (captioned spelling) on his chest

mentions.place: Snyder Avenue, South Philadelphia (bikers riding along the avenue)
mentions.speaker: Spencer (guest)
mentions.quote: I was uh big into like photographing the bikers that were just kind of going along Snider Avenue.
mentions.locationEvidence: Named street ('Snider Avenue' = Snyder Avenue) right after 'I'd moved to South Philly at this point' (4:28). No cross street given, so only the corridor is supported, not a block.
mentions.notes: Stated as his own habit but in the past tense ('was big into'), so it may not be a current haunt. He also describes one specific frame from that period (4:46-4:52: 'this guy was trying to pop a wheelie. He ended up crashing and I kind of caught the moment right before he fell down'), which by context is on Snyder but is not explicitly re-located. Not shot in this video.

mentions.place: Clothespin sculpture, Centre Square plaza, 15th & Market St (across from City Hall)
mentions.speaker: Spencer (guest)
mentions.quote: It's a big clothes pin. She loves this clothes pin. It's a Yeah. iconic Philadelphia landmark that we pass by every time we go out for a walk.
mentions.locationEvidence: Only one 'big clothes pin' that is an 'iconic Philadelphia landmark': Oldenburg's Clothespin at 15th & Market. 'this clothes pin' means they are standing next to it during today's walk.
mentions.notes: Strict reading: he says they PASS BY it on every walk, not that he shoots it, and no frame is described here. It is included because it is the only named anchor for where today's walk (and his routine walk) runs: Center City around 15th & Market / City Hall. Treat as route evidence, not a confirmed shooting spot. The opening '>> Closer.' on this line is probably the child or Spencer talking to her; attribution of that one word is uncertain.
